headline: The final tower: Auri and Shaolong
title: How to Beat the Final Tower in Palworld | Auri and Shaolong | Palworld Guide
video_script: The last regular tower boss in Palworld one point zero is Auri and Shaolong, in Sunreach. But you can't just walk in. First, shut down all six barrier devices around Auri's tower. Then head inside for the fight. Shaolong is Water and Dragon, so Electric and Ice Pals work best. Beat this fight, and you've cleared every regular tower, which is your key to the World Tree endgame. Did you beat Auri yet? Comment below!
description: Palworld 1.0 final regular tower: shut down the six barrier devices around Auri's tower in Sunreach, then beat Auri and Shaolong (Water/Dragon - use Electric or Ice) to open the way to the World Tree.
